pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃpi sādiyanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃpi sādiyanti santiṭṭhantipi sallapantipi saṅketaṃpi gacchanti purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyanti channaṃpi anupavisanti kāyaṃpi tadatthāya upasaṃharanti etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃpi sādiyissanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃpi sādiyissanti santiṭṭhissantipi sallapissantipi saṅketaṃpi gacchissanti purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyissanti channaṃpi anupavisissanti kāyaṃpi tadatthāya upasaṃharissanti etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāyāti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃpi sādiyanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃpi sādiyanti santiṭṭhantipi sallapantipi saṅketaṃpi gacchanti purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyanti channaṃpi anupavisanti kāyaṃpi tadatthāya upasaṃharanti etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃpi sādiyissanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃpi sādiyissanti santiṭṭhissantipi sallapissantipi saṅketaṃpi gacchanti purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyissanti channaṃpi anupavisissanti kāyaṃpi tadatthāya upasaṃharissanti etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃ vā sādiyeyya saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃ vā sādiyeyya santiṭṭheyya vā sallapeyya vā saṅketaṃ vā gaccheyya purisassa vā abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyeyya channaṃ vā anupaviseyya kāyaṃ vā tadatthāya upasaṃhareyya etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya ayampi pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā aṭṭhavatthukāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.10: manussapuriso na yakkho na peto na tiracchānagato viññū paṭibalo kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.12: hattho nāma kappuraṃ upādāya yāva agganakhā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.13: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya ubbhakkhakaṃ adhojānumaṇḍalaṃ gahaṇaṃ sādiyati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.15: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya nivatthaṃ vā pārutaṃ vā gahaṇaṃ sādiyati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.17: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse tiṭṭhati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.19: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse ṭhitā sallapati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.21: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya purisena itthannāmaṃ okāsaṃ āgacchāti vuttā gacchati pade pade āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.24: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya purisassa abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyati āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.27: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ okāsaṃ paviṭṭhamatte āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.29: etassa asaddhammassa paṭisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse ṭhitā kāyaṃ upasaṃharati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.33: seyyathāpi nāma tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo punaviruḷhiyā evameva bhikkhunī aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūrentī assamaṇī hoti asakyadhītā tena vuccati pārājikā hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.35: saṃvāso nāma ekakammaṃ ekuddeso samasikkhātā eso saṃvāso nāma
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.36: so tāya saddhiṃ natthi tena vuccati asaṃvāsāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.2.11: uddiṭṭhā kho ayyāyo aṭṭha pārājikā dhammā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.2.12: yesaṃ bhikkhunī aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure tathā pacchā pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā.
